main_text.l: quid ex hac disputatione orietur, tibi decrevi mittere. Multa enim ejusmodi à nobis habent amici, etiam quaedam, quae à me profecta esse fortasse non meminerim si ostendant mihi. Quo in loco apud te futura sint, non magnopere laboro. Sat est, si semel legeris. Vale, Lugduni Batavorum VII. Eid. Iunii Iuliani. MDCIIII.

page.notes: The date line is set in small capitals, and the last numeral is printed as CIIII; I have converted it to MDCIIII following the rule for the reversed-C numerals, but the printed form may be read differently. "VII" is read from a worn scan and may be VIII. The word at the right below the text is set in italic and is taken as a catchword.
